sections.executive_summary: The archived signal layer is healthy—11 backtest runs show positive 7-day excess across buy (+2.03%), hold (+1.36%), and strong_buy (+1.21%) tiers—but forward paper tracks remain underperforming versus ^FTSE after costs (verdict: underperforming). Primary ai_judgment (-19.24% excess) beats the rules control (-28.26%) on cost-aware returns, while momentum_grace (-2.19%) and calibrated shadows r2/r3 (-2.34%) show the clearest churn improvement, though none beat the market benchmark yet. The single biggest modelling gap this week is assessment-model conviction/timing calibration: trajectory_evidence reports 383 labeled events with 1w directional hit_rate 0.4205 (n=302) and six model_focus_candidates flagging weak keys including hold->buy (1w positive_rate 0.25, n=20) and signal_unchanged (1w positive_rate 0.3782, n=275)—opinion-flip sign is not matching realized price. Secondary forensics point to quality-family scoring failures (11 of 55 loser_snapshot_cards) and exclusion step u2 now ready_for_priors with cumulative_exclusion_alpha 0.003748.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- Primary ai_judgment excess_after_costs: -19.24% vs ^FTSE benchmark_return +1.44%; control rules: -28.26% vs benchmark +2.54%; best paper track momentum_grace: -2.19% vs benchmark -0.72%.
- Primary beats control by +9.0 pp after costs (beat_control: true) but fails the success criterion (beat_market: false).
- Cost drag is the dominant forward drag: rules 30.5% on 51 trades; ai_judgment 23.0% on 34 trades; momentum_grace 2.9% on 5 trades—primary saves ~7 pp vs control but churn remains expensive relative to momentum_grace.
- Mark thickness is moderate for full-history tracks (equity_marks: rules 20, ai_judgment 19, momentum_grace 16; enough_history: true on all three) but ai_judgment's current epoch has only 1 equity mark ("Insufficient epoch marks for benchmark span"), so recent post-reseed performance is not yet independently benchmarkable.
- Sector concentration breaches the 20% cap on primary and control (max_sector_weight 0.3414 and 0.3376 respectively); momentum_grace respects cap at 0.20.
- Decision-review proposed no knob changes on any track; this review does not recommend auto-applying decision-review knobs.
sections.signal_backtest_findings:
- Archived backtest (run_count 11, history_run_count 11): 7-day excess returns—buy +2.03% (n=469), hold +1.36% (n=1410), strong_buy +1.21% (n=184), avoid +0.73% (n=418); insufficient_data -0.52% (n=4).
- Historical analysis (run_count 11, 4 observation weeks, window 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-30): smoothed 7d overlay:buy +2.12% (n=418); overlay:hold +1.58% (n=1508); overlay:strong_buy +1.12% (n=137); overlay comparison shows screen smoothed excess +1.97% vs overlay +1.88% (sample_count 653, downgrade_count 0)—broker overlay adds negligible lift this window.
- Offline simulation (11 periods): momentum_grace track +2.02% excess (25 trades, costs £32.67); static/trailing_levels -0.58%; research_overlay -8.84% (51 trades)—research overlay identical to screen-only per comparison_note.
- trajectory_evidence (snapshot_count 11, labeled_event_count 383): prediction_hit_rate_by_horizon—1w 0.4205 (n=302), 4w 0.517 (n=176), 8w 0.3659 (n=41), 12w unscored (n=0); weeks_to_realization: median 1 week, 62.65% realized within 12w, 93.9% within 4w (213/340 scorable). Upgrade events (n=51) show positive_rate 0.3529; downgrades (n=51) 0.5686—upgrade conviction sign is inverted vs price. model_focus_candidates (assessment-model hypotheses, not live-screen mutation): hold->buy (1w positive_rate 0.25, mean -0.008424, n=20); buy->strong_buy (0.3077, n=13); signal_unchanged (0.3782, n=275); strong_buy->buy (0.6, n=10); 1w directional (hit_rate 0.4205); 8w directional (0.3659, n=41).
- loser_snapshot_cards: card_count 55; cohort_counts avoid 43, failed_buy_alumni 12; top_failed_families—quality 11, dividend 8, garp 7, cheapness 4, risk 4. Sample pattern: avoid-tier names (e.g. AAL.L, AML.L) carry multi-family failures (quality+dividend+garp) with opinion_flip_triggers "passes quality family (currently failed)" despite screen avoid signal.
- exclusion_universe: recommended_step u2 ("Exclude avoid + timing wait"), cumulative_exclusion_alpha 0.003748, positive_alpha_rate 0.6, avg_filtered_pool_size 59.7 over 10 week_pairs; readiness.ready_for_priors true.
sections.paper_track_comparison:
- ai_judgment (primary): total_return -17.8%, excess_after_costs -19.24%, cost_drag 23.0%, 34 trades, 3 positions; uses adjusted_signal + require_research_accumulate vs control.
- rules (control): total_return -25.7%, excess_after_costs -28.26%, cost_drag 30.5%, 51 trades—highest churn and worst after-cost outcome.
- momentum_grace (experimental exit overlay): total_return -2.9%, excess_after_costs -2.19%, cost_drag 2.9%, 5 trades, 5 positions—best forward P&L and lowest cost drag of the three named tracks.
- Calibrated shadows show knob-prior path working: ai_judgment_calibrated -7.45% excess (11 trades); calibrated_r2/r3 both -2.34% excess (5 trades, 5–8 marks)—converging toward momentum_grace economics without live knob apply.
- knob_calibration_priors (observe_only): ai_judgment recommended_prior max_positions 5 / min_conviction 0.0 (confidence low; changed_vs_current: max_positions, min_conviction); rules same prior shape (confidence low); both tracks readiness.ready_for_priors false—retrospective only, not promotion-ready.
- exit_shadow: 0 closed exits on rules, ai_judgment, and momentum_grace (12 open on rules/ai_judgment)—cohort too thin for grace-vs-rotation learning; note explicitly says wait for thicker cohort.
- exit_timing_cohorts: not present in payload; exit_timing_near_miss readiness.ready_for_probability_analysis true with hold_closed_count 227 and swap_closed_count 236—hold recovery_rate 0.7445 (169/227 recovered to breakeven); swap_rotation replacement_outperformed 167/236.
- exclusion_ladder_replay: readiness.ready_for_shadow_spawn true on recommended_step_id u2; primary_return_delta_vs_actual +0.0589 over 13 replayed log entries (rules replay +0.1821 over 11 entries).
- hypothesis_integrity and hypothesis_outcomes: not present in payload.
sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [scoring] Offline conviction-timing overlay for weak transition keys (hold->buy, signal_unchanged, 1w/8w horizons) — test whether down-weighting upgrade conviction or delaying timing_wait flips raises 1w hit_rate above 0.4205 without mutating live assign_signal thresholds (N3 gate).
2. [scoring] Quality-family composite gate on avoid cohort — simulate requiring quality pass before any screen upgrade above avoid for names like AAL.L/AML.L (quality failed in 11/55 cards) — expected learning: quantify false-upgrade rate vs dividend/garp co-failure patterns.
3. [offline_sim] u2 exclusion ladder counterfactual on ai_judgment rebalance_log — replay "Exclude avoid + timing wait" (cumulative_exclusion_alpha 0.003748, pool ~60) against actual primary path — expected learning: validate whether archive alpha converts to return_delta comparable to ladder replay +0.0589 (human gate; no auto-apply).
4. [paper_knobs] Human-run ftse-exclusion-ladder-replay spawn-shadow for step u2 — forward observe shadow vs live primary now that ready_for_shadow_spawn true and 13 primary log entries replayed (never auto-spawn).
5. [paper_churn] Hold-vs-swap probability strand on near-miss archive — stratify 227 hold-closed (74.45% recovery) vs 236 swap-closed (167 replacement_outperformed) by conviction band pre_buy_0.28_0.45 — expected learning: identify when hold recovery dominates swap rotation to inform exit policy without crude mark stops.
